component.title: Transition
component.purpose: Expose a small declarative motion vocabulary without allowing consumers to fork lifecycle or reduced-motion behavior.

states.description: A settled shared transition is visible.
The same transition reverses through the shared Presence lifecycle.

claims.statement: Convenience kinds resolve to MotionPrimitive variants and Presence owns mounting, exit, interruption, and reduced-motion collapse.
Transitions animate opacity, transform, and filter only, preserving layout geometry while content enters or exits.
